description: This file defines custom flag types SelectiveStringValue and SelectiveStringsValue for handling validated string flags in Go, including methods for setting, retrieving, and listing valid values.

classes.name: SelectiveStringValue
classes.description: A struct implementing flag.Value for a single validated string.

classes.name: SelectiveStringsValue
classes.description: A struct implementing flag.Value for a list of validated strings.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Verifies and sets the string value if valid.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the current value as string.

methods.name: Valids
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all valid strings.

methods.name: NewSelectiveStringValue
methods.description: Creates a new SelectiveStringValue with provided valid options.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Verifies and sets a comma-separated list of strings if all are valid.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the list of selected strings joined by commas.

methods.name: Valids
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all valid strings.

methods.name: NewSelectiveStringsValue
methods.description: Creates a new SelectiveStringsValue with provided valid options.
